description: This Java class defines the KerlinkProvider, a LoRaWAN provider implementation for Kerlink devices. It implements the LoraProvider interface and provides methods for extracting device IDs and payloads from JSON messages, as well as defining relevant API endpoints and content types.

classes.name: KerlinkProvider
classes.description: A LoRaWAN provider implementation for Kerlink, offering methods to extract device IDs and payloads from incoming messages, and providing provider-specific configurations such as path prefix and accepted content type.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for the provider, which is 'kerlink'.

methods.name: pathPrefix
methods.description: Returns the API path prefix used for Kerlink messages.

methods.name: acceptedContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type string that this provider accepts for incoming messages.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts the device ID from the given JSON LoRa message.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload string from the given JSON LoRa message.
